column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “to Yahweh” is rendered “the Lord's.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mountain” is rendered “hill.”
The written Hebrew has “my soul”; NASB reads “his soul,” and renders “sworn to deceit” as “sworn deceitfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will lift up a blessing” is rendered “He shall receive a blessing.”
“Your face, O Jacob” is rendered “Your face—even Jacob”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “in” after “come.”
